browser.environment: Headless Chromium via Playwright, production Vite build served locally; no physical devices tested.

current_gallery_initial_open.scope: Search and focus, lazy loading, real GLB render, four presets and their selected states, keyboard activation, scrolling, rotate, zoom, reset, close and focus restoration; no horizontal overflow or reported errors for these three viewport runs.

browser.narrow_320x720: Rendered and reached the end of the same functional assertions, but the run failed on a GLB request reported as net::ERR_ABORTED and a response-completion timeout.
browser.navigation_reload: A separate current-build run displayed the model after direct navigation and reload, but failed its GLB network-completion check after one request was reported net::ERR_ABORTED. In a diagnostic, the browser performance entry reported all 4184100 bytes for that request and the model rendered; the cause of the contradictory network event was not established.
browser.review_page: Local review.html tested at 1440x900 and 390x844: ten SVG images loaded, all three file links resolved, no page errors or horizontal overflow.

rebuild.note: Independent no-render rebuild after UV quantization; render images from the same unchanged scene geometry.
